main_text.l: minorum hoc silicet in veris certisq; patri-bus multo magis faciendum esse. Hanc conclusionem ornat egregio persimate[?], quo effecta[?] sive fructus beneficiorum in proximos collaturum exponit: Fructus enim ingenii, virtutis, omnisq; praestantiae tum maxime capitur, cum in proximum quemq; confertur. Vt igitur ii. Per comparationem parium etiam inferioribus praeceptum tradit: Vt enim superiores se aequare cum inferioribus debent: sic inferiores dolere non debent se a suis superari. Huius praecepti ratione[?]m reddit a factis utriusq;: quia superiores saepe inferioribus beneficia exprobrant: inferiores vero semper queruntur aliquid, & se contemni putant. Primum igitur genus reprehendit argumento adjunctorum: odiosum est genus hominum beneficia exprobrationem: eusq; rationem reddit a relatis. Beneficia meminisse debet is qui accepit: non commemorare qui dedit. Alterum genus reprehendit argumento effectorum: nam qui se contemni putat molestias faciunt amicitias: 2.explicatione subiecti contemtionis: ÿ contemnuntur fere, q[?] contemnendos se arbitratur. page.notes: Uncertain readings: "persimate" (line 3) and "effecta" (word split across lines 3–4) are not clear in the scan; "ratione[?]m" is a reconstruction at the line end and should be checked against the scan. The words "exprobrationem: eusq;" in the seventeenth line are unclear and may be misread; the printed form appears to be "exprobrationem: e jusq;" with a reference mark. "ÿ" and "q[?]" in lines 24–25 are doubtful. The line "tur. Vt igitur ii." contains an illegible-looking "ii" that may be a printed numeral or a reference. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. u/v and i/j were normalised per the rules.
